caption: The drawing depicts the luxurious interior of a railway carriage. The walls and ceiling are decorated with ornate wooden panels featuring floral and geometric carvings in shades of warm brown and gold. The ceiling is painted green with gold trim, and several elaborate brass lamps with white glass shades hang from it. Along both sides of the carriage, plush red velvet seats with carved wooden armrests and floral-patterned, light-colored antimacassars are arranged in pairs, each seat separated by a narrow aisle carpeted in dark green with a subtle pattern. On the left, a cane and a dark hat rest against the paneling, while a brown coat and a black bag lie on the nearest seat. There is a doorway at the far end of the carriage, partially covered by dark green curtains. The windows are framed with wood, and gold decorative fixtures are seen throughout the area, including above the seats and along the ceiling. A wicker basket with a blue handle and a pink item placed on the floor is visible next to one of the seats.
title: Parlor in Pullman Coach
